exercises.why: **договорить** — договори́ть (perfective): to finish speaking/saying/telling. Wiktionary: до- + говори́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: My grandfather used to say that.
exercises.why: **говаривал** — гова́ривать (imperfective): to say (repeatedly or frequently). Wiktionary: говори́ть + -ивать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: I said something I shouldn't have.
exercises.why: **наговорил** — наговори́ть (perfective): to record, to read for recording, to have one's reading recorded; (colloquial) to slander; to say, to tell (a lot); to bewitch. Wiktionary: на- + говори́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **наговорил** — наговори́ть (perfective): to record, to read for recording, to have one's reading recorded; (colloquial) to slander; to say, to tell (a lot); to bewitch. Wiktionary: на- + говори́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Are you in league with him?
exercises.why: **сговорился** — сговори́ться (perfective): to come to terms, to come to an agreement; to plot, to gang up. Wiktionary: с- + говори́ть + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to articulate, to pronounce, to utter
to talk, to have a talk, to speak (to, with)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: загова́ривать — to begin to talk; выгова́ривать — to articulate, to pronounce, to utter; переговори́ть — to talk, to have a talk, to speak (to, with); договори́ть — to finish speaking/saying/telling.

exercises.q: He must have conspired with his grandfather.
exercises.why: **сговорились** — сговори́ться (perfective): to come to terms, to come to an agreement; to plot, to gang up. Wiktionary: с- + говори́ть + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?
